Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.body: Which of these terms matter most to you: price, payment timing or contract length?

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We can accept your terms and await your order. Our Angebot includes a price of €438.21 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

To address your question, price stability and payment timing are our primary priorities. Due to strict company guidelines, our pricing is currently fixed and we cannot accommodate any price reductions. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
